description:
The PROOF, in the background (minutes): compare (row counts of every table with every
    difference explained, every carried value, trial balance per account and per partner, open
    receivables/payables, payment states, reconciliations, quants, stock and manufacturing states,
    valuation, next number of every sequence, document-name md5, sha1 of every carried file) and
    the PER-USER functional smoke (get_views + web_search_read AS each real user on every model
    they may read - the superuser hides access bugs; `logins` picks users, default a sample of
    real internal + portal users). Writes nothing to the business data (smoke rolls back).
    Poll data_pump_status for the verdict.

    path='pump' (built by data_pump_run, uses its id map) or path='upgraded' (a database upgraded IN
    PLACE by Odoo's official service or OpenUpgrade - record ids are preserved, so the proof uses an
    identity map built in memory and writes nothing into that database). Same checks either way, so
    both data paths are judged by the same proof.
name: data_pump_verify
